t.id: Berapa banyak penyimpanan yang direncanakan PLN?
t.en: How much storage does PLN plan?

j.id: RUPTL 2025-2034 memuat 50 proyek penyimpanan bernama dengan total 6641 MW: sekitar 3658 MW BESS dan 2983 MW PLTA pompa (hitung sendiri dari tabel RUPTL).
j.en: The 2025-2034 RUPTL lists 50 named storage projects totalling 6641 MW: about 3658 MW of BESS and 2983 MW of pumped hydro (own calculation from the RUPTL tables).

j.id: Indonesia Battery Corporation, usaha patungan BUMN (Pertamina, Antam, Inalum, PLN) yang menjadi mitra Hyundai dan LG di HLI Green Power dan mitra CATL dan Antam di proyek Dragon.
j.en: Indonesia Battery Corporation, a state-owned joint venture (Pertamina, Antam, Inalum, PLN) that is partner to Hyundai and LG in HLI Green Power and to CATL and Antam in the Dragon project.

t.id: Apakah ada pabrik sel baterai di Indonesia?
t.en: Is there a battery cell factory in Indonesia?

j.id: Ya. HLI Green Power di Karawang berkapasitas 10 GWh per tahun diresmikan 3 Juli 2024; proyek CATL, Antam, dan IBC dengan 6,9 GWh tahap I dimulai pembangunannya 29 Juni 2025.
j.en: Yes. HLI Green Power in Karawang with 10 GWh a year was inaugurated on 3 July 2024; the CATL, Antam and IBC project with 6.9 GWh in phase I broke ground on 29 June 2025.

t.id: Apa beda BESS dan PLTA pompa?
t.en: What is the difference between BESS and pumped hydro?

j.id: BESS cepat dibangun dan merespons dalam milidetik, untuk durasi pendek; PLTA pompa lambat dan padat modal, tahan puluhan tahun, untuk durasi panjang.
j.en: BESS is fast to build and responds in milliseconds, for short durations; pumped hydro is slow and capital-heavy, lasts decades, for long durations.

j.id: Risiko nyata: Moss Landing (California) terbakar pada 16 Januari 2025 dan Victorian Big Battery (Australia) terbakar saat uji pada 2021. Standar keselamatan dan jarak dari permukiman menentukan.
j.en: The risk is real: Moss Landing (California) burned on 16 January 2025 and the Victorian Big Battery (Australia) caught fire during testing in 2021. Safety standards and distance from settlements matter.

t.en: What happened to LG in Indonesia?

j.en: LG Energy Solution exited a battery ecosystem project worth about USD 8.45 billion in April 2025; government said Huayou would replace it. See chapter 40.

t.en: How much do batteries cost now?

j.id: BloombergNEF mencatat harga paket baterai lithium-ion rata-rata dunia USD 115 per kWh pada survei akhir 2024, turun 20 persen dalam setahun. Harga sistem BESS utuh (termasuk inverter dan konstruksi) jauh lebih tinggi dan belum dikumpulkan di basis ini.
j.en: BloombergNEF recorded a global average lithium-ion pack price of USD 115 per kWh in its late 2024 survey, down 20 percent in a year. The full BESS system price (including inverters and construction) is much higher and not collected in this base.

t.en: What is the difference between LFP and NMC?

j.id: LFP (lithium besi fosfat) lebih aman dan tahan siklus panjang sehingga umum untuk penyimpanan jaringan; NMC (nikel mangan kobal) lebih padat energi sehingga umum untuk kendaraan. Indonesia memiliki nikel sehingga mendorong NMC untuk hilirisasi.
j.en: LFP (lithium iron phosphate) is safer and longer lived, so common for grid storage; NMC (nickel manganese cobalt) is more energy dense so common in vehicles. Indonesia has nickel, which pushes NMC for downstream industry.

j.id: Sel LFP modern umumnya dirancang ribuan siklus; umur praktis 10 sampai 15 tahun dengan penurunan kapasitas bertahap. Contoh bab 5 memakai degradasi 2 persen per tahun sebagai asumsi hipotesis.
j.en: Modern LFP cells are typically designed for thousands of cycles; practical life is 10 to 15 years with gradual capacity fade. The chapter 5 example uses 2 percent a year degradation as a hypothetical assumption.

t.id: Apa itu BESS co-located dengan PLTS?
t.en: What is a BESS co-located with solar?

j.id: Baterai dipasang di lokasi PLTS agar surplus siang dapat digeser ke malam dan jaringan stabil; contoh di Indonesia adalah 14,2 MWh di PLTS IKN 50 MW.
j.en: A battery installed at the solar site shifts midday surplus to night and stabilises the grid; the Indonesian example is 14.2 MWh at the 50 MW IKN solar plant.

t.id: Apa risiko bila penyimpanan tidak cukup?
t.en: What is the risk if storage is short?

j.id: IEA menghitung kasus baterai rendah dapat menunda hampir 500 GW surya yang dibutuhkan untuk melipattigakan terbarukan 2030, memperpanjang pemakaian batubara dan gas.
j.en: The IEA calculates that a low battery case could delay close to 500 GW of solar needed to triple renewables by 2030, prolonging coal and gas use.

t.id: Apakah baterai bekas kendaraan bisa dipakai lagi?
t.en: Can used EV batteries be reused?

j.id: Bisa untuk penyimpanan stasioner (second life) setelah kapasitas turun sekitar 70 sampai 80 persen, tetapi uji kondisi dan standar keselamatan wajib; daur ulang diatur baku mutu emisi Permen LHK 12/2021.
j.en: Yes, for stationary storage (second life) after capacity falls to about 70 to 80 percent, but condition testing and safety standards are required; recycling is governed by Environment Ministry Reg. 12/2021 emission standards.

paragraf.id: Penyimpanan membuat listrik surya dan bayu dapat dipakai saat tak ada matahari dan angin, dan menjaga frekuensi jaringan. Hornsdale di Australia Selatan menunjukkan responsnya sekitar 100 milidetik dibanding 6.000 milidetik pada layanan frekuensi konvensional.
paragraf.en: Storage lets solar and wind power be used when sun and wind are absent and keeps grid frequency stable. Hornsdale in South Australia showed a response of about 100 milliseconds versus 6,000 milliseconds for conventional frequency services.

paragraf.id: Indonesia merencanakan 6641 MW penyimpanan dalam RUPTL 2025-2034, tetapi di basis METI belum ada yang berstatus beroperasi: pipeline besar, realisasi baru dimulai.
paragraf.en: Indonesia plans 6641 MW of storage in the 2025-2034 RUPTL, but none is marked operating in the METI base: a large pipeline with delivery only starting.

paragraf.id: Topik ini juga mencakup ekosistem baterai nikel (IBC, HLI Green Power, proyek CATL) karena sel baterai Indonesia dipasarkan terutama ke kendaraan listrik, dan BESS jaringan memakai teknologi yang sama.
paragraf.en: This topic also covers the nickel battery ecosystem (IBC, HLI Green Power, the CATL project) because Indonesian cells are mainly marketed to electric vehicles and grid BESS uses the same technology.

paragraf.id: Penyimpanan menggeser waktu: listrik surya dan bayu yang melimpah di satu jam dipindah ke jam lain. Itu sebabnya penyimpanan diukur dua angka sekaligus, daya (MW) dan energi (MWh), dan durasi adalah rasio keduanya.
paragraf.en: Storage shifts time: abundant solar and wind power in one hour is moved to another. That is why storage is measured by two numbers at once, power (MW) and energy (MWh), and duration is their ratio.

paragraf.id: Penyimpanan juga memberi layanan jaringan yang tidak terlihat di tagihan: respons frekuensi dalam milidetik, cadangan, dan penundaan investasi jaringan. Nilai ekonomi proyek bergantung pada layanan yang dibayar, bukan hanya arbitrase harga.
paragraf.en: Storage also gives grid services invisible on bills: millisecond frequency response, reserves and deferral of grid investment. Project value depends on which services are paid for, not only price arbitrage.

rumus.id: Energi keluar (MWh) = energi masuk (MWh) x efisiensi round-trip
rumus.en: Energy out (MWh) = energy in (MWh) x round-trip efficiency

rumus.id: Pendapatan arbitrase = energi keluar x harga jual - energi masuk x harga beli
rumus.en: Arbitrage revenue = energy out x sell price - energy in x buy price

rumus.id: Energi tersedia (MWh) = kapasitas nominal (MWh) x DoD x (1 - degradasi tahunan) pangkat umur (tahun)
rumus.en: Available energy (MWh) = nominal capacity (MWh) x DoD x (1 - annual degradation) to the power of age (years)

rumus.id: LCOS (USD per MWh) = (CAPEX x faktor anuitas + biaya O&M tahunan) / energi dilepas per tahun + biaya pengisian / efisiensi
rumus.en: LCOS (USD per MWh) = (CAPEX x annuity factor + annual O&M) / energy discharged per year + charging cost / efficiency

rumus.id: Faktor anuitas = r x (1 + r) pangkat n / ((1 + r) pangkat n - 1), dengan r suku bunga dan n umur proyek
rumus.en: Annuity factor = r x (1 + r)^n / ((1 + r)^n - 1), with r the discount rate and n project life

contoh.id: Hornsdale awal 100 MW / 129 MWh berdurasi 1,29 jam; setelah ekspansi 150 MW / 193,5 MWh juga 1,29 jam (EST, hitung sendiri).
contoh.en: Original Hornsdale at 100 MW / 129 MWh lasts 1.29 hours; after expansion 150 MW / 193.5 MWh it is also 1.29 hours (EST, own calculation).

contoh.id: Pabrik HLI 10 GWh per tahun disebut cukup untuk lebih dari 150.000 kendaraan listrik; itu setara sekitar 66.7 kWh per kendaraan (EST, hitung sendiri dari angka pemberitaan).
contoh.en: The 10 GWh a year HLI plant is described as enough for over 150,000 electric vehicles; that is about 66.7 kWh per vehicle (EST, own calculation from press figures).

contoh.id: Analisis METI (Hipotesis): durasi 2 jam cocok untuk menggeser surya ke malam di sistem kecil; untuk Jawa-Bali durasi lebih panjang dari PLTA pompa tetap dibutuhkan.
contoh.en: METI analysis (Hypothesis): two-hour duration suits shifting solar to evening in small systems; for Java-Bali longer duration from pumped hydro is still needed.

contoh.id: BESS contoh 100 MW / 200 MWh (durasi 2 jam), efisiensi 88 persen: tiap siklus melepas 176 MWh. Pada 330 siklus per tahun energi dilepas 58.1 GWh (EST, semua asumsi hipotesis).
contoh.en: Example BESS 100 MW / 200 MWh (2 hour duration), 88 percent efficiency: each cycle discharges 176 MWh. At 330 cycles a year the energy discharged is 58.1 GWh (EST, all assumptions hypothetical).

contoh.id: Dengan degradasi 2 persen per tahun, kapasitas 200 MWh turun menjadi sekitar 163 MWh pada tahun ke-10 (EST).
contoh.en: With 2 percent annual degradation the 200 MWh capacity falls to about 163 MWh in year 10 (EST).

contoh.id: LCOS contoh tanpa biaya pengisian: CAPEX hipotesis USD 250 per kWh = USD 50 juta, faktor anuitas 0.1168 (8 persen, 15 tahun), O&M 2 persen CAPEX per tahun menghasilkan sekitar USD 118 per MWh dilepas (EST; angka CAPEX hanya ilustrasi, bukan harga pasar).
contoh.en: Example LCOS without charging cost: hypothetical CAPEX USD 250 per kWh = USD 50 million, annuity factor 0.1168 (8 percent, 15 years), O&M 2 percent of CAPEX a year gives about USD 118 per MWh discharged (EST; the CAPEX figure is illustrative, not a market price).

paragraf.id: Untuk BESS jaringan, insentif utama adalah pembelian oleh PLN lewat RUPTL; insentif fiskal khusus penyimpanan tidak ditemukan di sumber yang dibaca. Standar emisi daur ulang baterai ada di Permen LHK 12/2021.
paragraf.en: For grid BESS the main incentive is PLN procurement through the RUPTL; no storage-specific fiscal incentive was found in the sources read. Battery recycling emission standards sit in Environment Ministry Reg. 12/2021.

paragraf.id: Kewajiban: TKDN untuk kendaraan listrik berbasis baterai (Permen Perindustrian 6/2022) dan baku mutu emisi daur ulang (Permen LHK 12/2021). Untuk BESS jaringan belum ada standar keselamatan kebakaran nasional yang ditemukan di basis ini; kasus Moss Landing dan Victorian Big Battery menjadi pelajaran.
paragraf.en: Obligations: local content rules for battery EVs (Industry Reg. 6/2022) and recycling emission standards (Environment Reg. 12/2021). No national fire safety standard for grid BESS was found in this base; the Moss Landing and Victorian Big Battery cases are lessons.

paragraf.id: Insentif: pembelian PLN lewat RUPTL; kendaraan listrik memperoleh insentif PPN (Permen Keuangan 38/2023, 8/2024, 12/2025) yang menciptakan pasar hilir sel. Insentif fiskal khusus penyimpanan stasioner belum ditemukan.
paragraf.en: Incentives: PLN procurement through the RUPTL; EVs receive VAT incentives (Finance Reg. 38/2023, 8/2024, 12/2025) that create a downstream cell market. No fiscal incentive specific to stationary storage was found.

paragraf.en: RUU EBET is under deliberation (METI archive 8 September 2026; stage not checked against the DPR site). Storage safety standards became a legislative issue elsewhere: California adopted new standards and legislation after Moss Landing.

paragraf.id: Masukan yang layak diajukan lewat forum Konsultasi: standar keselamatan BESS, definisi penyimpanan sebagai layanan jaringan, dan tarif layanan frekuensi.
paragraf.en: Inputs worth submitting through the Consultation forum: BESS safety standards, defining storage as a grid service and tariffs for frequency services.

paragraf.id: PLTA pompa tumbuh lagi: IEA memperkirakan tambahan sekitar 74 GW kapasitas dunia. PLN dilaporkan mengkaji PLTA pompa air laut 1 GW (Puger), sementara persaingan BESS menguat.
paragraf.en: Pumped hydro is growing again: the IEA forecasts about 74 GW of added global capacity. PLN is reported to study a 1 GW seawater pumped hydro (Puger) while BESS competition strengthens.

paragraf.id: Respons cepat baterai adalah inovasi terbukti: Hornsdale merespons dalam sekitar 100 milidetik dan memberi layanan frekuensi. Di sisi sel, pabrik Karawang berkapasitas 10 GWh dan 6,9 GWh tahap I menambah kemampuan produksi lokal.
paragraf.en: Fast battery response is a proven innovation: Hornsdale responds in about 100 milliseconds and delivers frequency services. On cells, Karawang plants of 10 GWh and 6.9 GWh in phase I add local production ability.

paragraf.id: Jenis kimia sel (LFP, NMC, natrium-ion) dan biayanya belum bersumber di bab ini.
paragraf.en: Cell chemistries (LFP, NMC, sodium-ion) and their cost are not sourced in this chapter.

paragraf.id: 1. Baterai natrium-ion: tanpa lithium, lebih murah dan tahan suhu rendah; tahap awal komersial, kepadatan energi lebih rendah daripada LFP.
paragraf.en: 1. Sodium-ion batteries: lithium-free, cheaper and cold tolerant; early commercial stage with lower energy density than LFP.

paragraf.id: 2. Baterai aliran (flow battery, vanadium): durasi panjang 4 sampai 12 jam, umur panjang, biaya awal tinggi.
paragraf.en: 2. Flow batteries (vanadium): long duration of 4 to 12 hours and long life, high upfront cost.

paragraf.id: 3. Sel LFP berkapasitas besar (di atas 500 Ah) menurunkan biaya per kWh dan jumlah sambungan sehingga mengurangi titik gagal.
paragraf.en: 3. Large-format LFP cells (above 500 Ah) cut cost per kWh and the number of connections, reducing failure points.

paragraf.id: 4. Penyimpanan udara terkompresi dan termal: durasi panjang tanpa mineral kritis; masih demonstrasi.
paragraf.en: 4. Compressed air and thermal storage: long duration without critical minerals; still demonstration stage.

paragraf.id: 5. PLTA pompa air laut: kajian PLN 1 GW (Puger); menghindari kebutuhan waduk atas.
paragraf.en: 5. Seawater pumped hydro: the PLN 1 GW study (Puger); avoids the need for an upper reservoir.

paragraf.id: 6. Grid-forming inverter: BESS yang membentuk tegangan jaringan sehingga cocok untuk sistem lemah dan pulau.
paragraf.en: 6. Grid-forming inverters: a BESS that forms grid voltage, suitable for weak and island systems.

paragraf.id: 7. Sistem pemadam khusus dan deteksi gas dini: tanggapan atas kasus Moss Landing dan ESS Korea.
paragraf.en: 7. Dedicated suppression and early gas detection: a response to the Moss Landing and Korean ESS cases.

paragraf.id: 8. Daur ulang hidrometalurgi: memulihkan nikel, kobal, dan lithium dari sel bekas; peluang rantai nilai di Indonesia (baku mutu Permen LHK 12/2021).
paragraf.en: 8. Hydrometallurgical recycling: recovering nickel, cobalt and lithium from used cells; a value chain opportunity in Indonesia (standards in Environment Reg. 12/2021).

paragraf.en: South Australia and California show two success paths: frequency services in a market that rewards speed (Hornsdale cut grid costs by about A$116 million in 2019 per Aurecon), and shifting solar to evening at tens of GW.

paragraf.id: Pelajaran gagalnya adalah keselamatan: kebakaran Moss Landing (2025) dan Victorian Big Battery (2021) memaksa aturan dan jeda uji. Indonesia sebaiknya menetapkan standar jarak, pemadam, dan uji bertahap sebelum memperbanyak BESS.
paragraf.en: The failure lesson is safety: the Moss Landing (2025) and Victorian Big Battery (2021) fires forced rules and testing pauses. Indonesia should set distance, suppression and staged-testing standards before scaling BESS.

paragraf.id: Indonesia merencanakan 6641 MW penyimpanan pada 2025-2034 sedangkan California sudah memiliki 16.942 MW baterai pada November 2025; dalam basis METI belum ada proyek penyimpanan yang berstatus beroperasi.
paragraf.en: Indonesia plans 6641 MW of storage over 2025-2034 while California already has 16,942 MW of batteries by November 2025; no storage project in the METI base is marked operating.

paragraf.en: On the cell value chain Indonesia is ahead: it already has a 10 GWh cell factory (Karawang) and is building a second.

paragraf.en: International cooperation is industrial and financial: Korea (Hyundai and LG Energy Solution in HLI), China (CATL, Brunp, Lygend, Huayou), and AIIB and World Bank loans for Upper Cisokan.

paragraf.en: METI analysis (Hypothesis): the shift from a Korean to a Chinese partner on a package of about USD 8.45 billion shows Indonesia swapping technology suppliers to keep its roadmap; open questions are technology transfer and local content.

paragraf.id: Dampak kebakaran Moss Landing: sekitar 1.200 warga dievakuasi; sampel udara permukaan tidak menemukan hidrogen fluorida, tetapi peneliti melaporkan kadar nikel, magnesium, dan kobalt yang sangat meningkat di sekitar lokasi.
paragraf.en: Moss Landing fire impacts: about 1,200 residents evacuated; ground air samples found no hydrogen fluoride, but researchers reported sharply elevated nickel, magnesium and cobalt near the site.

paragraf.id: Rantai pasok baterai Indonesia membawa isu tambang nikel di Halmahera Timur, peleburan, dan limbah; proyek Dragon juga mencakup daur ulang. Dampak lingkungan dan sosial tambang belum bersumber di bab ini dan perlu ditambah.
paragraf.en: The Indonesian battery supply chain brings issues of nickel mining in East Halmahera, smelting and waste; the Dragon project also includes recycling. Environmental and social impacts of mining are not sourced in this chapter and need to be added.

paragraf.id: Keselamatan: pendukung menunjuk bahwa studi Korea menyimpulkan baterai bukan penyebab satu-satunya kebakaran ESS (judul laporan), tetapi industri tetap terpukul; Moss Landing penyebabnya belum ditetapkan.
paragraf.en: Safety: supporters point out Korean investigations concluded batteries were not the sole cause of ESS fires (report headline) yet the industry took a hit; the Moss Landing cause is still undetermined.

paragraf.id: Industrialisasi: pemerintah menyebut pergantian investor lazim dalam proyek besar dan peta jalan tetap; kritik menyoroti ketergantungan pada mitra asing dan keberanian mundur LG yang menyebut kondisi pasar dan lingkungan investasi.
paragraf.en: Industrialisation: government says changing investors is common in large projects and the roadmap stays; critics note dependence on foreign partners and LG's willingness to exit citing market conditions and investment climate.

paragraf.id: Pertambangan nikel: pendukung hilirisasi menyebut nilai tambah; pengkritik menyorot deforestasi, limbah tailing, dan emisi smelter berbasis batubara. Kepentingan lingkungan dan industri belum terselesaikan dalam kebijakan.
paragraf.en: Nickel mining: downstream supporters cite added value; critics point to deforestation, tailings and coal-powered smelter emissions. Environmental and industrial interests are not yet reconciled in policy.

paragraf.id: Analisis METI (Hipotesis): Pengembang: nilai BESS ada pada layanan jaringan yang dikontrakkan, bukan pada arbitrase. Pemasok: prioritaskan sertifikasi keselamatan dan rencana pemadam sebelum menawarkan harga. PLN: tetapkan jenis layanan (frekuensi, geser surya, kapasitas) di tender. Pemda: tentukan jarak aman dan rencana darurat. Akademisi: data degradasi sel di iklim tropis masih langka.
paragraf.en: METI analysis (Hypothesis): Developers: BESS value lies in contracted grid services, not arbitrage. Suppliers: put safety certification and suppression plans before price. PLN: specify the service (frequency, solar shifting, capacity) in tenders. Local government: define safe distance and emergency plans. Academics: cell degradation data in tropical climates is scarce.

paragraf.id: Per peran: pengembang PLTS menambah BESS pada tender; integrator dan kontraktor siap melayani 3.658 MW BESS RUPTL; investor menilai risiko pasar tunggal (PLN); akademisi memverifikasi daur ulang dan baku mutu; pemda menyiapkan lahan dan rencana darurat.
paragraf.en: By role: solar developers add BESS to tenders; integrators and contractors can serve the 3,658 MW RUPTL BESS; investors assess single-buyer (PLN) risk; academics verify recycling and standards; local governments prepare land and emergency plans.

paragraf.en: To watch: (1) Upper Cisokan COD; (2) first production of the Dragon project in Karawang (a June 2026 report says the plant is complete, unverified); (3) details of LG's replacement in the package; (4) the first RUPTL BESS in operation; (5) the Moss Landing cause investigation.

paragraf.id: Metode: proyek dan MW dari tabel RUPTL yang diolah repo (dihitung ulang, ditandai EST), kasus luar negeri dari ringkasan Wikipedia dan berita yang ditautkan, dan kebijakan dari basis regulasi METI. Beberapa halaman (Energy-Storage.news, Bisnis, ADB) memblokir pengambilan otomatis; isinya hanya dipakai lewat ringkasan pencarian dan ditandai tingkat bukti media. Sintesis berlabel Analisis METI (Hipotesis). Batas: biaya BESS Indonesia, tarif, dan tenaga kerja belum ditemukan; status produksi proyek Dragon belum terverifikasi.
paragraf.en: Method: projects and MW from RUPTL tables processed by the repo (recomputed, marked EST), foreign cases from linked Wikipedia summaries and news, and policy from the METI regulation base. Some pages (Energy-Storage.news, Bisnis, ADB) block automated fetching; their content was used only through search summaries and marked media evidence level. Synthesis is labelled METI analysis (Hypothesis). Limits: Indonesian BESS cost, tariffs and employment were not found; production status of the Dragon project is unverified.

pelajaran.en: Small storage installed with the solar plant is a practical starting point for a new system.

sebab.en: State storage procurement policy and abundant daytime solar.

seharusnya.id: Struktur komitmen bersyarat dan mitra cadangan sejak awal paket, serta publikasi syarat yang menentukan keluar masuk investor.
seharusnya.en: Conditional commitment structures and standby partners from the package start, plus publishing the terms that govern investor entry and exit.

tanda_bahaya.id: Investor besar menyatakan kondisi pasar tidak mendukung.
tanda_bahaya.en: A major investor says market conditions do not support the project.

seharusnya.en: Treat repeated high-temperature incidents as a warning sign and test suppression at battery-room scale.
